description: Sites ferroviaires is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Location of railway sites in the Brittany and Pays de la Loire regions, with several items of information attached: Line number, technical typology. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Railway sites" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include PAYS DE LA LOIRE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
